text:
DNS::class
Description
This iRules command gets or sets the resource record class field
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled
as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
class
<
rr_obj
>
[
value
]
DNS::class <rr_obj> [value]
Gets or sets the resource record class field (e.g. IN, CH, HS)
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
